description: Swipe or scroll over the note to change it.

welcome.title: Welcome to Note Helper
welcome.description: Choose an instrument to explore notes and their positions.

meta.description: Interactive note helper for brass players. Learn notes in bass and treble clef and the matching slide and valve positions for trombone, horn, tuba and trumpet.
meta.keywords: trombone, horn, tuba, trumpet, note helper, bass clef, treble clef, slide positions, fingerings, music education

about.title: About Note Helper
about.intro: Note Helper is an interactive learning aid for brass players – for trombone, horn, tuba and trumpet.
about.feature1: Shows notes in bass or treble clef on a staff
about.feature2: Displays the matching slide or valve positions for the selected instrument
about.feature3: Scroll, swipe or use the arrow keys to move through the notes – works on touch and desktop
about.feature4: Adapts automatically to the selected instrument
about.feature6: The language follows your browser setting automatically
about.usage1: Choose your instrument on the home page.
about.usage2: Scroll, swipe or use the arrow keys to see different notes.
about.usage3: The matching positions are shown right away.
